items.content_html:
This removes the previously deprecated NIXOS_EXTRA_MODULE_PATH environment variable.
Related to #349549

Tested with

$ nix-instantiate nixos/lib/eval-config.nix --arg modules '[{fileSystems."/".device="x";boot.loader.grub.enable=false;}]' -A config.system.build.toplevel 
$ NIXOS_EXTRA_MODULE_PATH=$HOME/whatever.nix nix-instantiate nixos/lib/eval-config.nix --arg modules '[{fileSystems."/".device="x";boot.loader.grub.enable=false;}]' -A config.system.build.toplevel

This option has been previously deprecated and should be removed for release 25.05 according to the comments.
I have also added this change in the changelog, since the next release will be one year after the deprecation of this functionality and I removed the evaluation warnings.

items.content_html:
The current configuration options of the ddclient module force the use of login and password in the config file. However, porkbun instead uses apikey and secretapikey as credentials (ref. [https://ddclient.net/protocols.html](ddclient documentation)).
This forces you to either provide a full config file yourself, or write them into the extraConfig option, which is obviously not secure.

Therefore, I propose adding a new secretsFile option, which can be used to add any config that should remain secret such as the aforementioned apikey.

I verified that the new secretsFile option works by using the forked nixpkgs as an input on my nixos homeserver.

If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions, please let me know.

items.content_html:
Using n-g-c with --flake option will generate a config that is effectively unbuildable with nixos-rebuild (#181471) unless additional options are passed explicitly.
This will cause confusion for new users who aren't aware of what those additional options would be, and in any case, using --flake is an explicit statement that the system should support flakes.
Hence, we should enable said features in the config of those who are opting in in this manner.

Relevant:

  • #383033
  • #181471

This is a continuation of @eclairevoyant's work on #422717 and replaces #387594
